 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    if len(marks) < 2:
        return out
    marks.sort(key=lambda p: p[1])
    rmark, _, left_color = marks[0]
    _, _, right_color = marks[1]
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    top, bottom, left, right = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    mid_r, mid_c = (top + bottom + 1) // 2, (left + right + 1) // 2
    inner_top, inner_bottom = top + 1, bottom
    inner_left, inner_right = left + 1, right
    marker_above = rmark < top
    for r in range(inner_top, inner_bottom):
        for c in range(inner_left, inner_right):
            upper, is_left = r < mid_r, c < mid_c
            same_diagonal = (upper == is_left)
            use_left = same_diagonal if marker_above else not same_diagonal
            out[r][c] = left_color if use_left else right_color
    return out
"
}
